If the probe fails or times out, the self-check FAILS THE RENDER (log + return None) - never skip. Keep a generous but bounded timeout (120s).
3. MUX CONSISTENCY: keep -shortest at the mux, and ALSO self-check the muxed/cleaned program's AUDIO duration against map_total (>1 video frame delta = fail the render with a distinct log line naming audio). With (1) correct, audio and video agree; the check is the tripwire.
